prompt: How far from a crosswalk must you park in Texas?

decisions.prompt: You are parking at the curb before the crosswalk. How far back should your front bumper stop?

wrongActions.label: 5 feet back
wrongActions.consequence: Your car hid the crosswalk. A person stepped out from behind it and the next driver saw them only at the last moment.

wrongActions.label: 10 feet back
wrongActions.consequence: Your car hid the crosswalk. A person stepped out from behind it and the next driver saw them only at the last moment.

successText: You left the crosswalk in plain view. The person crossing and the next driver could see each other in good time.
ruleText: Do not park within 20 feet of a crosswalk at an intersection: a parked car that close hides people who are about to cross.

citation.source: Texas Driver Handbook (DL-7); Texas Transportation Code
citation.section: Handbook parking rules; Transportation Code Section 545.302(b)

verified: Read Nov 2026 in the official handbook PDF: "Within 20 feet of a crosswalk at an intersection".
